title: The Mystic Loktak Floating Escape
tagline: Sunset Phumdi Safari & Sangai Wildlife Discovery
places_summary: Loktak Lake & Sendra Island, Keibul Lamjao Floating Park, INA War Memorial, Loukoipat Eco Park
restaurants_summary: Moirang Fresh Fish & Loktak Eatery, Sendra Island Lakeview Restaurant
highlights: Phumdi boat cruise, dawn Sangai deer spotting, golden sunset dining over the lake, INA flag historical site
description: Escape into the world's only floating lake sanctuary. Wake up to misty waters, cruise past traditional fishermen, spot rare dancing deer, and savor authentic freshwater delicacies.

title: Royal Imphal & Living Cultural Legacy
tagline: Fortress Ruins, Classical Dance & Mother's Market
places_summary: Kangla Fort, Ima Keithel (Mother's Market), Shree Govindajee Temple, Manipur State Museum
restaurants_summary: Luxmi Kitchen, Chakluk Indigenous Meitei Kitchen, Chahao Black Rice Dessert Studio
highlights: Morning royal darshan at Govindajee, exploring ancient Kangla coronation halls, shopping at the 500-yr all-women market, multi-dish Meitei thali lunch, black rice desserts
description: Immerse yourself in centuries of Meitei royalty and vibrant street trade. Walk through royal coronation sanctums, witness the world-famous women's market, and relish legendary Manipuri cuisine.

title: Shirui Peak & Tangkhul Highlands Trek
tagline: Lily Summits, Pine Ridges & Paleolithic Caves
places_summary: Shirui Kashong Peak, Khangkhui Paleolithic Cave, Khayang Peak & Cascades
highlights: Alpine trek to Shirui summit, exploring prehistoric limestone cave chambers, bonfire under star-filled skies, authentic Tangkhul Naga smoked pork and king chilli feast
description: Conquer Manipur's most iconic mountain ridge. Trek through misty pine forests, discover ancient Paleolithic caverns, and immerse in Tangkhul hospitality with warm firewood bonfires.

title: Dzukou Valley & Northern Mystique Expedition
tagline: Rolling Emerald Hills & Ancient Stone Monoliths
places_summary: Dzukou Valley Border Trail, Mao Heritage Gate, Willong Khullen Stonehenge
restaurants_summary: Café 24 Lounge, The Asian Kitchen Imphal
highlights: High-altitude trek across endless green meadow ridges, photography at Willong's mysterious giant monoliths, cool mountain mist and terraced organic farms
best_season: June to September (Wildflower blooms) & October to January
description: A dream trek through the breathtaking emerald carpets of Dzukou Valley, capped with a visit to the prehistoric standing stone monoliths of Willong Khullen.

title: Andro Pottery & Countryside Craft Trail
tagline: Ancient Coil Pottery, Sacred Flame & Brookside Eco Park
places_summary: Andro Cultural Village, Santhei Natural Eco Park, Kaina Sacred Hill
restaurants_summary: Chakluk Indigenous Kitchen, Forage Organic Café
highlights: Handmade coil pottery masterclass, witnessing the ancient perpetually burning sacred fire, peaceful stroll by Santhei freshwater brook, jackfruit grove views at Kaina
description: Step back in time to an ancient craft hamlet. Learn centuries-old pottery without a potter's wheel, witness the sacred perpetual fire, and unwind along natural mountain stream pavilions.

title: Wild Tamenglong Rainforest & Caves Safari
tagline: Subterranean Caverns, Seven Cascades & Hornbill Orchards
places_summary: Barak Seven Waterfalls, Tharon Prehistoric Cave, Zeilad Lake Sanctuary
restaurants_summary: Ukhrul Smoked Meat House, Churachandpur Café de Tribal
highlights: Spelunking through 655m limestone labyrinth of Tharon Cave, trekking to the seven cascading steps of Barak falls, virgin jungle safari at Zeilad Lake, fresh orange orchard walks
best_season: October to April (Amur Falcon migration in Nov)
description: Venture deep into Manipur's lush western rainforest frontier. Explore subterranean river caverns, chase roaring tiered waterfalls, and witness flocks of hornbills across tropical canopies.

title: Southern Valleys & Waterfalls Odyssey
tagline: Triple-Tier Cascades, Ancient Brick Temple & Hilltop Botanical Gardens
places_summary: 15th-Century Vishnu Temple, Sadu Chiru Cascades, Pumlenpat Lake, Kakching Uyok Ching Garden
restaurants_summary: Meitei Ningol Kitchen, Sendra Island Lakeview Restaurant
highlights: Morning dip at the forest amphitheater of Sadu Chiru waterfalls, 550-year-old terracotta brick architecture, sunset panoramic tea at Kakching hilltop gardens, fresh farm dining
description: A delightfully balanced weekend retreat blending cascading waterfalls, ancient brick pagodas, serene wetland lakes, and manicured hilltop rose gardens.

title: The Grand Manipur Discovery Circuit
places_summary: Imphal Royal City, Loktak Floating Lake, Sangai Sanctuary, Shirui Alpine Peak, WWII Battlefields & Sadu Chiru Falls
restaurants_summary: Luxmi Kitchen, Forage Bistro, Moirang Fish Kitchen, Classic Fine Dining, Chahao Studio
highlights: The all-in-one quintessential Manipur journey covering royal palaces, floating lakes, alpine peaks, WWII history, and authentic regional feasts
description: The premier grand tour of Manipur. From sunrise on the floating circular islands of Loktak to the mist of Shirui Peak and the royal corridors of Kangla, experience the soul of the jewel of India.
